about: Apps the installer can offer. slug = Authentik application slug and the cloud.<domain>/<slug> path; host = public subdomain; stack = generic/stacks/<stack>. core apps are always installed.

essentials.name: Essentials
essentials.blurb: Photos, documents, passwords and a shared calendar.

family.name: Family
family.blurb: Essentials plus recipes, home inventory, music, paperwork, smart home and a family dashboard.

apps.name: Traffic router
apps.blurb: Routes each web address to the right app.

apps.name: Sign-in (Authentik)
apps.blurb: One account and one login for every app, with passkeys and two-factor.

apps.name: Photos
apps.blurb: Back up phone photos and videos; albums, faces and search.

apps.name: Office editor
apps.blurb: Edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in the browser (used by Documents).

apps.name: Documents
apps.blurb: Family files with in-browser editing.

hub.label: Documents
hub.description: Family files, Word and Excel in the browser

apps.name: Documents (OpenCloud)
apps.blurb: OpenCloud: family files and shared folders (the real media folders, kept in place) with ONLYOFFICE editing in the browser, plus desktop and phone sync apps. Alternative to Nextcloud on the same address.

apps.name: Passwords
apps.blurb: A shared password manager that works with the Bitwarden apps.

apps.name: Calendar & contacts
apps.blurb: Shared calendars and contacts that sync to every phone.

hub.label: Calendar help
hub.description: Calendars sync to your phone automatically; this is only for setup

apps.name: Recipes & meal plan
apps.blurb: Recipes, a weekly meal plan and shopping lists.

apps.name: Home inventory
apps.blurb: What the family owns and where it is.

hub.label: Where is it?
hub.description: What we own and where it lives

apps.name: Music
apps.blurb: Stream the family music library to any device.

apps.name: Paperwork
apps.blurb: Scan mail and bills; text search and automatic filing.

apps.name: Smart home
apps.blurb: Lights, sensors and automations (Home Assistant).

apps.name: Family hub
apps.blurb: A simple start page with a big button for every app.

apps.name: HeardOS desktop
apps.blurb: A desktop in the browser: every app opens signed in, in its own window, with this week's meals, shopping and budget as widgets. Installable as an app.

hub.label: Desktop
hub.description: All the apps in windows, plus this week at a glance

apps.name: Budget
apps.blurb: Household budgeting with bank sync (Actual Budget).

apps.name: Subscriptions
apps.blurb: Track recurring bills and renewals.

apps.name: Videos
apps.blurb: YouTube without ads or tracking.

apps.name: Books
apps.blurb: The family ebook library.

hub.label: Books
hub.description: Our ebook library (read in the browser or download)

apps.name: Speed test
apps.blurb: Check the connection speed to home from anywhere.

hub.label: Speed test
hub.description: How fast is the connection to home?

apps.name: Remote OCR
apps.blurb: Optional external text recognition for Paperless (advanced).

apps.name: Plants
apps.blurb: Houseplants and garden: watering tasks, photos, where each plant lives.

hub.label: Plants
hub.description: Watering, photos and where each plant lives

apps.name: Saved pages
apps.blurb: Keep a private copy of a web page before it disappears.

hub.label: Saved pages
hub.description: Keep a copy of a web page before it disappears

apps.name: Newsletters
apps.blurb: Family newsletters and holiday letters with public subscribe pages; sends through your outbound mail.

apps.name: Wikipedia
apps.blurb: All of English Wikipedia with pictures, stored at home and searchable offline (about 120 GB of disk).

hub.label: Wikipedia
hub.description: All of English Wikipedia, with pictures, stored at home

apps.name: Search
apps.blurb: Private web search with no tracking or ads; public so it can be every browser's search engine.

hub.label: Search
hub.description: Private web search, no tracking or ads

apps.name: AI filing for Paperless
apps.blurb: A small local AI model writes titles, correspondents and dates for new documents (CPU only, no cloud).

apps.name: Scheduled jobs
apps.blurb: CronMaster: the household's maintenance scripts and their schedules, with logs. Owner only.

apps.name: Torrent search
apps.blurb: bitmagnet: a private BitTorrent DHT search engine. Owner only.

apps.name: Soulseek
apps.blurb: Nicotine+: Soulseek file sharing into the music library, in the browser, routed out through the VPS. Owner only.

apps.name: Blog
apps.blurb: A public blog at your domain's root, rebuilt from the newsletter's public archive.

apps.name: Chat
apps.blurb: Open WebUI: chat with the HeardOS assistant (the model harness) and the local Ollama models. Admins only.
